game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 remake)

findings.name: Linear dungeon-by-dungeon structure kept
findings.detail: Faithful remake; same dungeons, same story beats, not open-world. Engadget: 'faithful remake that doesn't mess with the formula'. Child/adult split retained.
findings.trackable: New quest log shows current objective and where to go (Engadget, 80.lv).

findings.name: Inside the Great Deku Tree / Gohma
findings.detail: Child. Reward Kokiri's Emerald, Fairy Slingshot. Remake: floating platform now a collapsing wooden bridge; Gohma's arms guard weak spot while immune.

findings.name: Dodongo's Cavern / King Dodongo
findings.detail: Child. Goron's Ruby, Bomb Bag. No remake changes found.

findings.name: Lord Jabu-Jabu's Belly / Barinade (miniboss Big Octo)
findings.detail: Child. Zora's Sapphire, Boomerang. Remake: tunnels colour-coded; Big Octo arena lost spinning spikes and no longer reverses direction randomly (RPG Site + games.gg agree).

findings.name: Forest Temple / Phantom Ganon
findings.detail: Adult. Forest Medallion, Fairy Bow. Remake: Phantom Ganon energy ball always slow, no drifting after throw, dash attack in last phase; block-slider puzzle has no time limit; new lift NW room.

findings.name: Fire Temple / Volvagia
findings.detail: Adult. Fire Medallion, Megaton Hammer. Remake (Game8 via games.gg, single secondary source): heat now drains health immediately, no timer.

findings.name: Water Temple / Morpha (miniboss Dark Link)
findings.detail: Adult. Water Medallion, Longshot. Remake: adjusted to be less frustrating; some walls replaced with lattices; easier item swapping (Iron Boots on D-pad). Layout and water-level mechanic reportedly unchanged. Exact changes not fully detailed anywhere found.

findings.name: Shadow Temple / Bongo Bongo
findings.detail: Adult. Shadow Medallion, Hover Boots. No remake changes found.

findings.name: Spirit Temple / Twinrova
findings.detail: Child+adult. Spirit Medallion, Silver Gauntlets, Mirror Shield. Twinrova nerfed (RPG Site).

findings.name: Ice Cavern
findings.detail: No boss. Iron Boots, Blue Fire, Serenade of Water. Iron Boots needed for Water Temple, so effectively required for main progression in the original (unconfirmed for remake). finalboss.io labels it 'mini-dungeon' without saying optional.

findings.name: Bottom of the Well
findings.detail: No boss. Lens of Truth, entered as child. Game8 marks optional (via games.gg).

findings.name: Gerudo Training Ground (listed by games.gg as 'Gerudo Proving Grounds')
findings.detail: No boss, Ice Arrows, optional per Game8. Name 'Proving Grounds' may be a games.gg slip or a real remake rename; unverified. NOTE: finalboss.io lists Ice Arrows as optional detour.

findings.name: Ganon's Castle (games.gg: 'Ganondorf's Castle') / Ganondorf then Ganon
findings.detail: Six Sage trials (Forest, Water, Shadow, Fire, Light, Spirit) per TheGamer via games.gg; Golden Gauntlets in Shadow trial. Tower escape with Zelda has NO timer (differs from N64). Final Ganon fight has extra stages: Ganon regains Master Sword, uses lightning and ground slams, glowing forearm weak spots, then Zelda exposes forehead weak point.

findings.name: Ten main bosses, same order as original
findings.detail: Gohma, King Dodongo, Barinade, Phantom Ganon, Volvagia, Morpha, Bongo Bongo, Twinrova, Ganondorf, Ganon. Minibosses named: Big Octo, Dark Link (others, e.g. Dead Hand, Iron Knuckle, Stalfos, Flare Dancer, Poe Sisters etc., not itemised in sources read).

findings.name: Hall of Fallen Foes
findings.detail: NEW post-Forest-Temple feature (sources disagree on exact trigger: after Forest Temple per TheGamer and Nintendo Life; after returning Master Sword / Kaepora Gaebora in Kakariko per Shacknews/vulkk; Game8 says possibly after Prelude of Light). Entered by sleeping in a glowing green bed (any bed after first visit). Contains enemy statues (appear only after you defeat that enemy; description, location, best items), boss statues with Rematch option and personal timer, and silver owl statues starting boss gauntlets (young and adult versions, health carries over). Game8 lists 57 enemies and 27 bosses (work in progress). Rematch gear limited to what you would have at that point in story. Rewards unclear: RPG Site says bedroom shelf ornaments; Shacknews says Gold Rupee (200) chest before gauntlet; no leaderboards/modifiers. games.gg says every boss refightable 'after the credits' - conflicts with early unlock.
findings.trackable: Statues themselves show what you have defeated. Nintendo store page / Nintendo Everything say ZELDA NOTES (Nintendo Switch App) shows your Hall of Fallen Foes. Rematch timer records your time (whether best times persist unconfirmed).

findings.name: No new plot; some cutscenes extended and voiced
findings.detail: Lore unchanged. Voice acting for Zelda, Saria, Darunia, Ruto, Ganondorf etc. in major cutscenes; Link silent. Extended scene e.g. first Master Sword pull.

findings.name: Single ending; credits then back to title with pre-Ganon save intact
findings.detail: Per pro-gamer.gg (single source, blog-quality). RPG Site mentions a single save slot.

findings.name: No Master Quest, no Hero Mode, no New Game+ at launch
findings.detail: Stated by RPG Site, GBAtemp (via search summary), Nintendo Life (via RPG Site/search), pro-gamer.gg, Everything Edinburgh. No announced DLC/unlock.

findings.name: Game is easier overall
findings.detail: Jump button, free camera, sprint, nerfed bosses, new boss attacks rarely used and easy to dodge. Reviewers wish for a harder mode.

findings.name: Two new OoT amiibo (2027) unlock special in-game masks; existing Zelda amiibo give rewards
findings.detail: Out of scope for campaign but affects trophy design (cannot require 2027 amiibo).

findings.name: Estimated ~20h main, ~32h 100%
findings.detail: Single weak source.

trackableStats.where: Hall of Fallen Foes statues; also ZELDA NOTES app
Hall of Fallen Foes timer (persistence unconfirmed)

versionNotes.note: Remake vs N64/3DS: adds jump button, sprint, free camera, quest log, humming ocarina songs, voice acting, Hall of Fallen Foes; removes Ganon's tower escape timer; adds extra Ganon fight stages.
Master Quest (present in Master Quest N64/GC and 3DS) and Hero Mode (3DS) are NOT in the remake.
Price: $59.99 digital, $69.99 physical (80.lv). Release Nov 5 2026 Switch 2 exclusive.

gaps: Zelda Wiki (zeldawiki.wiki) and Nintendo Life review returned HTTP 403; neither was read. Official Nintendo page not read.

No single authoritative dungeon/boss list; relied on games.gg, finalboss.io and review summaries (secondary guide sites, some AI-ish quality). Dungeon names like 'Gerudo Proving Grounds' and 'Ganondorf's Castle' may be errors.
Medallion/stone rewards for Dodongo, Jabu, Forest etc. come from finalboss.io plus original-game knowledge; not confirmed against official remake sources.
Exact Hall of Fallen Foes unlock trigger and rewards conflict between sources; whether best times persist unknown; whether rematches have a 'defeat all' completion counter unknown.
Hall of Fallen Foes counts (57 enemies, 27 bosses) are from Game8 as WIP; not confirmed final.
Complete minibosses list and whether remake changed any (beyond Big Octo, Dark Link mention) not confirmed.

Whether the game has a completion percentage, an in-game counter for Gold Skulltulas/Heart Pieces, or any ending variations not covered by my beat; ending/credits-save behaviour is single low-quality source.
Whether Ganon's Castle Sage trials and Ice Cavern/Well are still optional/required as in original is not verified for remake.
